# Folder deletion uses the folder capability instead of the active spam destination

The patch removes the scan of configured spam destinations from command enablement and deletion. The accepted UI enables the command from online && deletable and the action checks folder.deletable. Local and IMAP capabilities reject SpecialUse flags, including Junk. Nonvirtual NNTP unsubscribe still has its own earlier branch. The changed test data checks that a Junk folder has no remove menu item; it does not execute every protocol deletion or establish a server policy.

Scope: Folder deletion command and capability.
